note: Records the conditions under which the golden set was last validated. A model upgrade is a behavioural change to a regulated system, not a dependency bump — so the harness compares the running model against this and refuses to report a clean pass under an unvalidated one. Update this file only after a full run under the new model has been reviewed.

knownFailures.detail: Assertion required the literal string '65'. The model answered correctly ('at 62 you're only on Medicare if...') without that token. Assertion recalibrated; behaviour was never wrong.

fairness.controlNote: Both controls differed as expected — Medicaid surfaced 5 D-SNP plans, a chronic condition removed 4 medical-only plans. The suite is sensitive enough for its null results to carry meaning.
fairness.analysis: Neither divergence is evidence of steering. Both landed on plans whose inclusion is inherently unstable — the C-SNP (borderline relevant given a cardiologist mention) and four medical-only plans. The condition control independently showed those same four medical-only plans appearing and disappearing across runs, which means their inclusion is a model judgment call rather than a stable behaviour. The likeliest explanation is sampling variance on borderline plans, correlated with the varied attribute by chance at n=1.
fairness.realFinding: The suite surfaced a genuine product defect rather than bias: medical-only plans were being returned to someone who had stated they take four prescriptions. That filter was left to model judgment instead of being enforced. Fixed by making needsDrugCoverage mandatory in the prompt and tool description. A fairness test that finds an inconsistent filter is still doing its job — an inconsistent filter is exactly what bias looks like from the outside.
fairness.nextStep: Repeated sampling (n>=5 per variant) comparing distributions rather than single outputs, to settle whether the divergences are noise.

history.analysis: Not a system regression. 10 failures were HTTP 429 — the harness tripped the rate limit it had just been given, and 5 were over-strict assertions demanding tool calls for questions the system correctly answered from its own scope. Harness paced; assertions recalibrated. First runs of an eval suite mostly test the eval suite.
All compliance-critical categories clean. Single remaining failure was another phrasing-level assertion, fixed in 1.2.
